title: Leg Lock Safety Hierarchy
shortDefinition: The safety order: recognize entanglement, hide heel, protect Knee Line, clear secondary leg, then exit with control.
whyItMatters: Leg locks can become dangerous quickly if you rotate wrong while Knee Line is trapped.
deepExplanation: The safety hierarchy prevents panic. Heel exposure is the signal, Knee Line is the boundary, secondary leg is the extra lock. Early tapping and clear communication are technical skills.
beginnerView: Do not rotate when heel is exposed and Knee Line is trapped.
advancedView: Read leg entanglements as control positions, not twisting races.
